description: START HERE for status questions ("what's down?", "how is everything doing?"). Returns the current status of every monitor (UP, DOWN, PENDING or MAINTENANCE) with its latest heartbeat message, lastBeatTime, type and tags. Filters: keywords, type, status, active, maintenance, tags, parent group. A push monitor that has stopped beating keeps its last status, so check lastBeatTime, which is UTC with no zone marker. For configuration use listMonitors; for history, listHeartbeats.

active.description: Filter by active status. true=only active monitors, false=only inactive monitors.

keywords.description: Space-separated keywords to filter monitors by pathName (case-insensitive fuzzy match). All keywords must match for a monitor to be included.

maintenance.description: Filter by maintenance status. true=only monitors in maintenance, false=only monitors not in maintenance.

parentId.description: Filter to the DIRECT children of this group monitor. Pass null for top-level monitors (those with no parent). Not recursive — use the group's own childrenIDs to walk deeper.

status.description: Filter by current heartbeat status, by number or name. Comma-separated for multiple statuses. 0=down, 1=up, 2=pending, 3=maintenance. Examples: "down", "0", "down,pending". Any other value is an error.

tags.description: Filter by tag name and optional value. Comma-separated for multiple tags. Format: "tagName" or "tagName=value". Monitor must have all specified tags. Case-insensitive. Examples: "production", "env=staging", "production,region=us-east"

type.description: Filter by monitor type(s). Comma-separated for multiple types. Use listMonitorTypes tool to see all available types.

name: getMonitorSummary

lastBeatTime.description: Timestamp of the heartbeat that `status` and `msg` come from, in UTC as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS" — Uptime Kuma sends no zone marker, so compare it against the current UTC time, not local time. Check this before trusting the status of a push monitor: one that has stopped beating reports its last known status indefinitely, and is otherwise indistinguishable from a healthy one.

title: Get Monitor Summary
